paragraphs.text: The proposer offers a two-section 15 kV arc-resistant metal-clad switchgear lineup, which complies with the specifications outlined in the RFP. This lineup includes eighteen 15 kV vacuum circuit breaker positions equipped with protective relays and controls, two revenue meter positions, two sets of 15 kV isolation switches, bus voltage transformers (VTs), and multi-ratio current transformers (CTs), as specified in the contract documents.

Additionally, the proposed switchgear lineup is designed to accommodate future bays that will be fully functional, excluding the vacuum circuit breakers (VCBs). This ensures scalability and adaptability to meet potential future requirements.
